passes.rule: A THIRD VARIANT OF THE BOUNDS DEFECT: a left bound too WIDE, admitting the note column. ch23/ch39 were bounds too narrow (clipping scripture OUT); ch41 a right bound too tight; this one lets apparatus IN. archive-holiebible-ot1 p48 sets its notes 0.08-0.20 with body from 0.21 while the band began at 0.14, so the column's right half counted as scripture: 'And Ma[God him]laleel liued', 'and be[recited life of]gat Enoch', '& begat [of bo.] Mathusala'. A verse is the concatenation of several lines, so a gloss admitted at each LINE END lands in the MIDDLE of the assembled verse - interleaving, not a tail. NEITHER EXISTING PROBE CAN SEE THIS: left_strip_probe only ever asks whether the body is CLIPPED, and bounds_probe holds the left bound unless it is. Neither has any way to say 'the bound admits too much'. Measured fix p48 (0.14,0.855)->(0.205,0.845), +2.
